title: Naotaka Shigeta
text:
I am a doctoral student at Nagoya University.
My research focuses on shock waves, compressible flows, and turbulence.



Shock waves
Compressible flow
Shock–turbulence interaction
Shock-wave/boundary-layer interaction
Experimental and computational fluid dynamics




This website presents my research activities, publications, and occasional notes and blog posts.
